items.do_not_say: "Increases sales." "Boosts conversion." "Pays for itself." "Drives revenue." Any ROI or lift figure
items.say_instead: "See what shoppers asked for, what they clicked, and what they added to cart." Revenue attribution is not measured, and the dashboard says so

items.do_not_say: "Pico never makes things up." "Zero hallucinations." "100% accurate."
items.say_instead: "Product cards show names, prices, and stock from your synced catalog."

items.do_not_say: "Live stock." "Real-time inventory." "Checks live stock."
items.say_instead: "Stock as of your last catalog sync." Add "updated by webhook on Shopify" only after the inventory webhook ships

items.do_not_say: "Only recommends what is in stock."
items.say_instead: "Shows stock on every card, and keeps out-of-stock items out of the cart."
phrases: Only recommends what is in stock

items.do_not_say: "AI-powered semantic search." "Understands what shoppers mean."
items.say_instead: "An AI model reads the request, then Pico matches it to your catalog by keywords, synonyms, and price range."

items.do_not_say: "Shoppers can buy right in the chat." "Checkout in chat."
items.say_instead: "One tap adds the product to your store's own cart."
phrases: Shoppers can buy right in the chat

items.do_not_say: "Compare products side by side."
items.say_instead: "Pico can compare products inside its reply."

items.do_not_say: "Pico remembers your shoppers."
items.say_instead: "The conversation survives a page reload on the same device."

items.do_not_say: "Shows you what customers want that you don't sell."
items.say_instead: "Shows phrases shoppers asked the assistant that returned no products or few clicks, which points to gaps in the catalog or in how products are described."
phrases: Shows you what customers want that you don't sell

items.do_not_say: "Sounds exactly like your brand."
items.say_instead: "Set personality, warmth, answer length, emoji use, clarification style, and up to 1,000 characters of tone guidelines."

items.do_not_say: "Fully multilingual." "Speaks every language."
items.say_instead: "Replies follow the shopper's language. Widget text is translated for 10 languages."

items.do_not_say: "Works with any store."
items.say_instead: "Built for Shopify." Shopware 6 and custom stores belong to a later go-to-market

items.do_not_say: "Installs itself." "No developer needed." "Zero setup."
items.say_instead: "Install from the App Store and follow a four-step checklist. Developers can hand the setup to a coding agent with Pico's setup skill."

items.do_not_say: "No impact on speed."
items.say_instead: The measured Lighthouse difference on Dawn, as published on the technical one-pager, once measured

items.do_not_say: "Free forever." "Unlimited."
items.say_instead: "Free covers 50 conversations a month."

items.do_not_say: "One plan for all your stores." "Built for agencies."
items.say_instead: "Each plan connects one store."
phrases: One plan for all your stores

items.do_not_say: Any install, store, merchant, review, rating, or conversation count for Pico
items.say_instead: Nothing. Pico is pre-launch. Use open proof from ops/copy-bank.md

items.do_not_say: Any testimonial, named merchant, logo, or case study
items.say_instead: Nothing until the proof log has an entry with exact wording, source, and recorded permission

items.do_not_say: "Your store is losing sales." "Shopify's search is broken."
items.say_instead: "Shoppers who can't find a product by browsing can ask for it."

items.do_not_say: "Smarter than Shopify search." Any claim that a Shopify tool lacks something
items.say_instead: Do not compare. Describe what Pico does

items.do_not_say: "Cheaper than Chatty." "Unlike other chatbots." Any named comparison
items.say_instead: No comparison in copy that customers see without a sourced, dated, page-loaded finding, rechecked before each use

items.do_not_say: "Pay with InstaPay." EGP prices in Shopify copy
items.say_instead: Nothing. Shopify installs bill in USD through Shopify Billing

items.do_not_say: "No surprise charges. Pico pauses before it bills you more." before the pause ships
items.say_instead: "A quota meter shows usage on the Plan & Usage page." Use the pause line once the quota behavior is SHIPPED
phrases: No surprise charges. Pico pauses before it bills you more

items.do_not_say: "Earn recurring revenue." "Guaranteed leads." Any income or traffic number
items.say_instead: "Partners earn 25% of each referred store's subscription for 24 months." Merchants who ask for setup help are offered listed partners

items.do_not_say: "Join the Pico Partner Program" before week 6. "Certified partner." "White label."
items.say_instead: "Paid usability sessions: we pay you $150 to install Pico on a store you work on and tell us what works and what breaks."

items.do_not_say: "We'll feature your agency in a case study."
items.say_instead: "With your client's written permission, we write up what changed on their store and credit your work."
phrases: We'll feature your agency in a case study

items.do_not_say: Any rate other than 25%, 30%, and 10% managed
items.say_instead: The published terms only, quoted exactly

items.do_not_say: A partner invitation, outside link, or email request inside Upwork or Fiverr
items.say_instead: Nothing on the platform. Implementers find picofinds.com/partners on their own

items.do_not_say: "The only assistant that sticks to your catalog."
items.counter_example: Manifest AI, Wantly, Fast Simon, and dozens of App Store listings describe catalog-only answers, and Lyro skips out-of-stock items.
items.say_instead: "Built around your synced catalog."
phrases: The only assistant that sticks to your catalog

items.do_not_say: "Only Pico shows unanswered questions."
items.counter_example: Shopify Search & Discovery reports search-bar terms with no results and no clicks, and Tidio lists questions Lyro could not answer.
items.say_instead: insight into what shoppers asked the assistant.

items.do_not_say: "The Arabic AI shopping assistant."
items.counter_example: Arabic-first Shopify apps exist (Luma, shamz.ai), Salla ships Arabic AI search, Fin and Lyro answer in Arabic.
items.say_instead: "Arabic replies display right to left, with a language switcher and separate merchant copy per language." GCC copy only, later.

items.do_not_say: "No vendor pays implementers before a referral."
items.say_instead: Holds for every program found on 2026-11-03, internally. In copy, describe Pico's offer, never the others'.
phrases: No vendor pays implementers before a referral

items.do_not_say: "A sandbox no competitor offers."
items.say_instead: Holds for the slates checked on 2026-11-03. Internal only, and recheck before any use.
